title: Reference notifications feed a full origin into build_entity_url, producing a double-scheme (broken) email CTA URL
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1309: "let origin = domain_helpers.origin_from_domain(row.origin_domain)" | domain_helpers.gleam:29-31: "True -> "http://" <> domain" / "False -> "https://" <> domain" | notification_dispatch.gleam:477-479: "cta_url: email_client.build_entity_url(" / "          origin_domain:," / "          path: "/vacancies/"" | email_client.gleam:895-899: "let domain = case origin_domain {" / """ -> "righttenantry.ie"" / "    d -> d" / "  }" / "  "https://" <> domain <> path"
detail: origin_from_domain returns a scheme-full origin ("https://righttenantry.ie"); build_entity_url prepends "https://" unconditionally, yielding "https://https://righttenantry.ie/vacancies/<id>/applications/<id>" — a dead link in all three reference-notification emails. Pre-existing callers (notification_dispatch.gleam:62) pass the raw scheme-less stored domain. AC1/AC3/AC4 notifications dispatch, but the CTA URL is malformed.
recommended_fix: Pass row.origin_domain (raw stored domain) instead of origin_from_domain(row.origin_domain) as origin_domain: to notify_reference_completed/declined/objected, or strip the scheme before build_entity_url.

title: form_session.completion_seconds is emitted as null at submit although the spec's result-structuring Dev Notes pin rc3-4 as the writer
evidence: result.gleam:466-467: "        // completion_seconds is filled by rc3-7 from the row's timestamps." / "        #("completion_seconds", json.null())," | spec Dev Notes: "`fraud_signals`: structured with the `form_session` block (`completion_seconds` from `form_opened_at`->`submitted_at`, the `_focus_seconds` the form carried); line-type/DB-reuse signals are rc3-7
detail: Spec contradiction: the result-structuring Dev Notes make completion_seconds rc3-4's job, while the spec's own Completion Notes defer it to rc3-7. Implementation follows the Completion Notes. Deterministic and honest (null), but the pinned AD-9 form_session shape is not fully populated at submit.
recommended_fix: Either compute completion_seconds from form_opened_at->submitted_at in the submit handler per the Dev Notes, or explicitly amend the spec's result-structuring section to pin the rc3-7 deferral.

title: AC8 CSRF-stack test asserts only not_equal(403), weaker than the spec-pinned 2xx/3xx assertion
evidence: reference_exit_routes_integration_test.gleam:402-409: "  let submit = post("/reference/" <> token)" / "  submit |> should.not_equal(403)" / "  let decline = post("/reference/" <> token <> "/decline")" / "  decline |> should.not_equal(403)" / "  let stop = post("/reference/" <> token <> "/stop")" / "  stop |> should.not_equal(403)" / "  let wrong = post("/reference/" <> token <> "/wrong-person")" / "  wrong |> should.not_equal(403)"
detail: Spec Dev Notes pin: "exercise each POST through the full `router.handle_request` + middleware stack asserting 2xx/3xx (not a 403 CSRF rejection)". A route that 404s (missing arm) or 500s would pass these assertions, so the pin doesn't prove reachability — only the absence of a 403.
recommended_fix: Assert response.status is 200 or 303 (e.g. should.equal(200) or a 2xx/3xx predicate) per route, matching the pinned AC8 contract.

title: character_ref verification block omits the spec-pinned free_text_signals[] field
evidence: result.gleam:164-173: "fn character_verification(draft: Draft) -> json.Json {" / "  json.object([" / "    #("identity_confirmed", str_or_null(draft, "identity_confirmed"))," / "    #("relationship", str_or_null(draft, "relationship"))," / "    #("capacity", str_or_null(draft, "capacity"))," / "    #("known_duration", str_or_null(draft, "known_duration"))," / "    #("character_statement", str_or_null(draft, "character_statement"))," / "    #("would_stand_again", str_or_null(draft, "would_stand_again"))," / "  ])" / "}" | spec Dev Notes: "`character_ref`: `identity_confirmed`, `relationship{+capacity}`, `known_duration`, `character_statement`, `would_stand_again`, `free_text_signals[]`.
detail: The pinned per-slot block for character_ref lists free_text_signals[]; landlord (result.gleam:139) and employer (result.gleam:158) emit it, character does not. Data-equivalent today (the character form has no free-text question), but the pinned AD-9 shape is incomplete for downstream readers (RC4 panel).
recommended_fix: Add #("free_text_signals", free_text_signals(draft)) to character_verification so all three slots emit the pinned field.
